name: NFC Nürnberg Boys
tagline: Every session, every match — full heart.
description: Our senior men's side is the club's founding team, made up of players from across the Nepali community in Nürnberg and nearby towns. Mixed ages, mixed backgrounds, one badge.

name: NFC Nürnberg Girls
tagline: Building the future of Nepali women's football in Nürnberg.
description: Our girls' team launched alongside the boys' side in 2025 to give women in the community a regular, welcoming place to train and play — from complete beginners to experienced players.
